en-US.name: Junk Drawer
en-US.summary: Remember where you put things, and what you need to do.
en-US.description: Tell the junk drawer where you put something or what you need to remember, then ask for it back later. Link it to your Junk Drawer account once with a code from the app.
examplePhrases: Alexa, tell junk drawer to remember my keys are in the hall closet
Alexa, ask junk drawer where are my keys
Alexa, ask junk drawer what's on for today

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Generate a link code in the Junk Drawer app, then say: Alexa, tell junk drawer to link <code>.
